name: nuxt-a11y-slider
description: Accessible, SSR-first, PageSpeed-friendly slider for Vue 3 / Nuxt 4 with a Splide-like API

scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && nuxi dev playground
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare playground
scripts.build:playground: npm run dev:prepare && nuxi build playground
